ruling: Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-24): the creative director is the ai-harness insight-desk skill with a thin adapter in each growth engine, all five wired now; no separate repo until the graduation trigger fires.

skill.name: insight-desk
skill.read: get_skill('insight-desk') once ai-harness admits it; until then a local ai-harness checkout, else unavailable and the engine runs as before

north_star.state_line: NOW.md, the north-star-state comment under "Where it is right now"

taste: get_approved_taste for repository krishanraja/growth-legibility, venture legibility
live: Control Center's prior-outreach route and the invitations already prepared in the latest private report under runtime/

humour.why: unavailable: Control Center serves POST /api/growth/engines/legibility/humour (capped at 200 calls a day), but it takes only humour-engine's published prompts by SHA-256 and returns a reading that only humour-engine's validators interpret; that package is Python and this engine is JavaScript with no copy of it, and its copy doctrine is plain and evidence-led. The transport reports features.humour so the gap stays visible.

divergent.route: npm run divergent on this engine's bearer (POST /api/growth/engines/legibility/divergent, only when capabilities say features.divergent), else the connector's divergent_score, divergent_record and divergent_run from a session on Krish's account; score and record first (free), paid moves only when a session asks at U4 or U5, under Control Center's caps (1 diverge, 20 quick calls, $5 a day; a 429 is final); a run with neither records unavailable

blind_reader: fresh-context sub-agents from a Claude session, as scripts/reader.mjs sends them; never the session that wrote the ideas

hook.how: npm run reader -- brief --input <file> --insight <sheet>: a valid sheet's ideas become insight:<idea id> angles beside the three fixed ones; without --insight nothing changes

approval: stage plan behind strategy on Krish's list, and only while the engine is active; while config/activation.json or Control Center holds it, the sheet stays local and puts no ask on his list
cadence: at most one sheet a week
